svg.title: Assign Process
svg.desc: Assign Process Assign process information to welding trajectories. Links the previously defined process parameters to the corresponding weld lines before the welding sequence is analyzed. Process Data Linking: Connects previously created process parameters with the selected welding trajectories. Project Data: Ensures that each weld contains the necessary process information for later cycle-time calculations, simulation, or report generation.
